batch_contract: one row per question; rows right-padded with pad id 50283; attention_mask 1 real / 0 pad; marker_pos padded with 0 and marker_mask False; the CPU reference pads to the longest row of the call, the device pads to the seq bucket and the row bucket; padding changes fp32 logits by at most about 4e-6 (doc/probe/README.md)
backend_contract: forward(input_ids int64 [B,S], attention_mask int64 [B,S], marker_pos int64 [B,kmax], marker_mask bool [B,kmax], qtype int64 [B] with choice 0 / score 1 / noul 2) -> (logits float32 [B,kmax] with -1e4 where marker_mask is False, act_logits float32 [B,2]); shapes() describes the geometry
host_tail: temperature = temperature_by_options[temp_bucket(type, k)] else temperature[type], clamped to [0.5, 5.0] as pip laya 0.3.27 does (plan amendment A6; the Hub rl_agent_api.py uses the raw value, which differs only for choice:11+); p = softmax(logits[:k] / temperature) in float32; confidence = 1 - H(p)/log k; answer_confidence = max p; score = sum(i p_i); noul = p[1]; act_probability = softmax(act_logits)[0]
